edbDesc: (or Thrust Damping) is the effect of rocket exhaust removing energy from the transverse angular motion of a rocket. If a rocket has pitch or yaw motion then the exhaust must be accelerated laterally as it flows down the exhaust tube and nozzle. Once the exhaust leaves the nozzle this lateral momentum is lost to the vehicle and thus serves to damping the lateral oscillations.
title: Jet Damping
pickWhy: A small damping of a rocket's wobble by its own exhaust; too weak and narrow to do a job beyond rocket design margins.
